summary.lv: Senior UI/UX Designer Ubiquiti Latvia komandā – projektēt gala-līdz-galam produkta pieredzes tīmekļa, datora un mobilajām platformām, sadarbojoties ar inženieriem no koncepta līdz palaišanai.
summary.en: Senior UI/UX Designer at Ubiquiti Latvia – design end-to-end product experiences for web, desktop, and mobile, collaborating with engineering from concept to launch.
